# Sweepr — Day-of-Service Demo

> A live demo of what a Sweepr customer sees on the day of their booked
> cleaning: real-time cleaner location tracking, arrival windows, and job
> status updates. Part of Sweepr, a home-cleaning marketplace operated by
> ClearKey Solutions, LLC.

## Key pages

- [Demo](https://service.getsweepr.com/): Interactive day-of-service tracking demo.
- [Sweepr marketing site](https://getsweepr.com/): Book a cleaning, see pricing and FAQ.
